payload.title: NVIDIA Blackwell Tensor Core Analysis (Part 1)
payload.summary: A preliminary analysis of Blackwell (B200/SM100) Tensor Core features based on PTX ISA 8.7 documentation, covering compatibility, instruction set, memory layout, block scaling, and synchronization.

sections.heading: 1. Key Takeaways
sections.gist: - B200 is **not backward-compatible** with H100 Tensor Core code; separate development is required - B200 Tensor Core code will likely **not be forward-compatible** with the next generation (Rubin) - B200 Tensor Core programming may be **m…

sections.heading: 3. Compatibility
sections.gist: In PTX ISA, instructions with an "a" suffix on the compute capability version are exclusive to that version.

sections.heading: 4. 5th Generation Tensor Core Instructions
sections.gist: Generations 1–3 are called WMMA, generation 4 is WGMMA, and generation 5 is simply referred to as "5th gen."

sections.heading: 5. 5th Generation MMA Operations
sections.gist: Supported data types: - `.kind::f16`: FP16 and BF16 - `.kind::tf32`: TF32 - `.kind::f8f6f4`: arbitrary FP8/FP6/FP4 combinations - `.kind::i8`: signed/unsigned INT8 - `.kind::mxf8f6f4` / `.kind::mxf4`: MX floating point - `.kind::mxf4nvf4`:…

sections.heading: 6. Packing Formats in Tensor/Shared Memory
sections.gist: Tensor Core output elements are always 32-bit.

sections.heading: 7. Matmul Tensor Memory Layout
sections.gist: Since Tensor Core output element size is always 32-bit regardless of input type (TF32 or FP4), the D matrix has only 8 possible layouts in Tensor Memory.

sections.heading: 8. Block Scaling
sections.gist: Microscaling format tensors have corresponding BlockScaling tensors.

sections.heading: 9. Sparse Matrices
sections.gist: All Blackwell data types support structured sparsity on the A matrix.

sections.heading: 10. Tensor Core Collector Buffer
sections.gist: The Tensor Core contains an internal collector buffer that can cache A or B matrix data.
